themes.name: Dark
themes.note: The app follows the device or the member's choice (Account & security › Appearance). Code blocks stay dark, email, page and phone previews stay light (.keep-light), publisher pages and the landing page are light only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, numbers, icons at rest. The light theme's code-block surface is the same colour (code-bg).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions under headings, table body text that is not the key, neutral badge text.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Labels and metadata (the .k style): timestamps, units, column headers, helper text under inputs.

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text, footnotes on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-nav
tokens.usage: Site navigation links and the HTML tag colour in code panes.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background behind cards and the hover fill of secondary buttons.

tokens.name: ground-2
tokens.usage: Landing hero and footer bands, wizard side panels.

tokens.name: ground-3
tokens.usage: Inset panels inside a card (authentication results, code previews).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, header, inputs, buttons, table rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card and panel borders, header and sidebar dividers, table header rule.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside cards, bar tracks, neutral badge fill, sidebar hover.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button borders and inactive stepper rings.

tokens.name: line-input
tokens.usage: Input, select and textarea borders. 3.1:1 against white, the minimum WCAG 1.4.11 asks of a control boundary.

tokens.name: line-hover
tokens.usage: Border of a card or button on hover, spinner track.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand colour: primary buttons, links, active nav, focus rings, the logo mark, progress on the current step.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button and link hover.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Active nav item fill, selected row, selected tab background on mobile.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: The highlighted column in comparison tables and the 'before you send' feature cards.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Border of a highlighted card.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Decorative blobs on the landing hero; never for UI.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a 2px outline with 2px offset on every focusable element (:focus-visible). Never removed.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Pass / Healthy / Delivered badge fill and the done-step ring.

tokens.name: ok-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icon on ok-bg.

tokens.name: ok-line
tokens.usage: Border of a success panel; done-step ring stroke is #86efac.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Success panel fill ('Round trip 2.4 s. Webhooks work.').

tokens.name: ok-bar
tokens.usage: Solid green for bars, dots and the live-sending indicator.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Warn / Warming up / Degraded badge fill.

tokens.name: warn-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icon on warn-bg.

tokens.name: warn-bar
tokens.usage: Solid amber for bars and dots. 3.8:1 against the bar track, so it passes WCAG 1.4.11 for non-text contrast.

tokens.name: bad-bg
tokens.usage: Block / Auto-paused / Outage badge fill.

tokens.name: bad-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icon on bad-bg.

tokens.name: bad-bar
tokens.usage: Solid red for bars and the blocked-step marker.

tokens.name: bad-strong
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill, the pulse ring of an auto-pause badge.

tokens.name: bad-line
tokens.usage: Border of an alert card.

tokens.name: bad-tint
tokens.usage: Alert card fill.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Informational badges: Scheduled, Draft review, Sandbox.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Text on info-bg.

tokens.name: neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Neutral badge fill: counts, Step 4 of 6, Open source.

tokens.name: neutral-fg
tokens.usage: Text on neutral-bg.

tokens.name: purple-bg
tokens.usage: Badges for automations and MCP agents.

tokens.name: purple-fg
tokens.usage: Text on purple-bg.

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: The sidebar and the icon rail.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Things that float above a screen: menus, popovers, dialogs, the jobs tray. In the dark theme they are one step lighter than cards, so they read as nearer.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, text areas, option cards. In the dark theme a field is a step darker than its card, so it reads as a place to type.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover and keyboard-highlight fill of buttons, menu items and rows. The ground in the light theme; in the dark theme a step lighter than cards and menus, so a highlighted item comes forward.

tokens.name: hover-soft
tokens.usage: The lighter hover fill of table rows, list rows and cards you can open. Ground-3 in the light theme; in the dark theme a step above cards, so the row comes forward.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in fields (4.5:1 on field).

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Loading skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: shimmer
tokens.usage: The highlight that sweeps over a skeleton.

tokens.name: muted-line
tokens.usage: Dashed outlines, empty-slot borders and other lines that must still meet 3:1.

tokens.name: muted-ink
tokens.usage: Muted icons and the off state of a switch.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The backdrop behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: on-strong
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a strong fill: accent, bad-strong, the status bars, inverse. White in the light theme, near-black in the dark one, where the strong fills are light.

tokens.name: on-fixed
tokens.usage: Text on colours that are the same in both themes: avatars, workspace and identity palettes, brand colours, chart series.

tokens.name: on-light
tokens.usage: Text on fills that are light in both themes (a pale chart segment, a light identity colour).

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Inverted chips: tooltips, toasts, the selected segment, count bubbles. Ink in the light theme, near-white in the dark one.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code panes and terminal blocks. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on inverse (a toast's detail line).

tokens.name: inverse-faint
tokens.usage: Icons at rest on inverse (a toast's close button).

tokens.name: inverse-line
tokens.usage: Borders on inverse (a toast's action button); 3:1 on inverse in the dark theme.

tokens.name: inverse-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on inverse.

tokens.name: switch-off
tokens.usage: The track of a switch that is off (3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Warning panels and banners (with warn-line).

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Border of warning panels.

tokens.name: warn-line-strong
tokens.usage: Border of warning notes and alerts that must stand out.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warn-tint and warn-bg panels.

tokens.name: ok-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ok-tint panels.

tokens.name: ok-line-strong
tokens.usage: Border of done steps and success alerts.

tokens.name: bad-ink
tokens.usage: Text on bad-tint panels.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Stronger border of error alerts.

tokens.name: bad-wash
tokens.usage: Hover fill of destructive buttons, removed lines in diffs.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Information panels and banners (with info-line).

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Border of information panels.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on info-tint panels.

tokens.name: info-strong
tokens.usage: Information icons, links and bars that need more weight than info-fg.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Stronger border of information alerts.

tokens.name: purple-line
tokens.usage: Border of purple (AI, beta) panels.

tokens.name: purple-tint
tokens.usage: Purple (AI, beta) panel fill.

tokens.name: dark-surface
tokens.usage: Terminal panel inside the dark install section.

tokens.name: dark-line
tokens.usage: Borders and hover fill on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: dark-text
tokens.usage: Body text on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: dark-muted
tokens.usage: Lead paragraph on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: dark-cursor
tokens.usage: Blinking cursor in terminal blocks.

tokens.name: code-tag
tokens.usage: Tag names in code panes on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: code-attr
tokens.usage: Attribute names in code panes.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: String values in code panes.

tokens.name: chart-gmail
tokens.usage: Mailbox provider series, fixed order: Gmail first.

tokens.name: chart-outlook
tokens.usage: Mailbox provider series: Outlook.

tokens.name: chart-yahoo
tokens.usage: Mailbox provider series: Yahoo.

tokens.name: chart-icloud
tokens.usage: Mailbox provider series: iCloud.

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: Mailbox provider series: Other, always last and grey.

tokens.name: chart-ses
tokens.usage: Sending provider series: Amazon SES.

tokens.name: chart-postal
tokens.usage: Sending provider series: Postal.

tokens.name: chart-postmark
tokens.usage: Sending provider series: Postmark.

tokens.name: chart-tier-1
tokens.usage: Engagement tiers: Active. In the dark theme the ramp runs from light (Active) to deep (Sunset), so the most engaged tier still has the most contrast.

tokens.name: chart-tier-2
tokens.usage: Engagement tiers: Cooling.

tokens.name: chart-tier-3
tokens.usage: Engagement tiers: At risk.

tokens.name: chart-tier-4
tokens.usage: Engagement tiers: Sunset.

tokens.name: badge-tier-3-fg
tokens.usage: Text on an At risk tier badge (chart-tier-3). Ink in the light theme; near-black in the dark one, where the ramp's mid blue takes dark text.

tokens.name: badge-tier-4-bg
tokens.usage: The fill of a Sunset tier badge, under ink. chart-tier-4 in the light theme; in the dark one no text reaches 4.5:1 on Sunset's deep blue, so the badge takes the deeper info blue.

tokens.name: chart-human
tokens.usage: Human opens; the figure of the opens chart.

tokens.name: chart-machine
tokens.usage: Machine opens (Apple Mail prefetch); the ground of the opens chart.

tokens.name: chart-score-1
tokens.usage: Contact score bands (ordinal): Cool. In the dark theme the ramp runs deep to light, so Hot keeps the most contrast.

tokens.name: chart-score-2
tokens.usage: Contact score bands: Warm.

tokens.name: chart-score-3
tokens.usage: Contact score bands: Hot.

tokens.name: chart-spam
tokens.usage: Placement tests: copies that landed in spam (bars, legends, trends).

tokens.name: chart-track
tokens.usage: Empty track behind every bar.

tokens.name: publisher-accent
tokens.usage: Sample publisher brand (Acme) on public pages: buttons and links. Replaced by each workspace's own brand colour.

tokens.name: publisher-ground
tokens.usage: Sample publisher page background.

families.sans: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'IBM Plex Sans Fallback', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

styles.name: app-title

styles.usage: Wizard and settings page titles. One per screen.

styles.name: app-h1
styles.usage: Screen title in the top bar.

styles.usage: Default text: paragraphs, table cells, list rows.

styles.name: app-body-strong
styles.usage: Row titles, names, the key cell of a table.

styles.name: app-caption

styles.name: app-overline
styles.usage: Uppercase table headers and group labels.

styles.name: app-number
styles.usage: Headline numbers in stat tiles. Always tabular figures.

styles.name: mono-code
styles.usage: Code panes, MJML and HTML views, DNS records.

styles.name: mono-inline

styles.name: mono-terminal
styles.usage: Terminal blocks on the landing page and install docs.

styles.name: mk-display
styles.sample: The newsletter platform that protects your inbox placement.

styles.name: mk-lead

styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a section heading, max 720px wide. 16px on phones.

styles.usage: Landing body text and the public pages.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Component padding uses 8 to 20; card gaps 12 to 24; page sections 28 to 72.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a badge dot and its text; micro gaps.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked captions, badge horizontal padding (8px on larger badges).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and rows, between badges.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a group, input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards on phones, padding of compact cards, bottom tab bar padding.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding on the landing page, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Content padding on tablets and in the rail layout; gap between cards on tablets.

tokens.name: space-4.5
tokens.usage: Card padding (18px 20px) in the app.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card horizontal padding; gap between columns in a wizard.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between major columns; wizard gutter; landing wrap padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Content padding on desktop (28px); wizard padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between landing sections' inner groups.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of landing sections; gap between hero columns.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Cover inset; large section spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of dark and HostRepute landing sections.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Hero vertical padding; phone content bottom padding above the tab bar; icon rail width.

radius.note: Rounded but not soft. Small controls 8, cards 10, marketing cards 14, badges and bars pill.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small chips, code line highlights.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, inset panels, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tab bar items on phones, the logo mark (7px at 26px).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Landing cards and feature tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, bars, dots, stepper numbers.

shadow.note: Borders carry structure; shadows only lift the few things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-rgb
tokens.usage: The colour of one-off shadows, as rgb(var(--shadow-rgb) / alpha).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Buttons on hover, dragged nodes in the flow editor.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Feature cards on hover, modals.

tokens.name: shadow-hero
tokens.usage: The one floating card in the landing hero.

tokens.name: shadow-accent
tokens.usage: Primary button hover on the landing page.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.

duration.note: Short for feedback, longer for entrances. Every animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and focus transitions on buttons, links, cards.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Card lift, tab switch, badge pop.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Entrance rise, bar growth on first paint.

tokens.name: duration-count
tokens.usage: Number counters in the hero.

tokens.name: duration-loop
tokens.usage: Pulse on the auto-paused dot; one cycle.

tokens.name: ease-out-soft
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or grows.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Hover transitions.

tokens.name: ease-step
tokens.usage: Cursor blink.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Marquees and spinners.
